results.title: Globex Energy - Who we are
results.content: Globex Energy develops and operates grid-scale battery storage in Texas and Arizona. Founded in 2011 and headquartered in Houston, Globex has 4.2 GWh of storage in operation and is led by CEO Maria Ortega.

results.title: Globex Energy profile - Grid Ledger
results.content: Globex sells capacity and frequency-response services to utilities under 10- to 15-year contracts. The company is privately held and reported positive operating cash flow in 2024.

results.title: Storage developers to watch
results.content: Globex was among the fastest-growing independent storage developers in 2024, adding 1.1 GWh of capacity. Analysts cite its long-term utility contracts as a source of predictable revenue.
